Name: Gluttony
Effect: This Pokémon can eat any type of food, medicine or herbal medicine with no negative. This Pokémon may have up to three berries as held item instead of just one. The berries must not be of the same effect.
Description: This Pokémon eats all day long, it is always carrying food and has no problem to find food sources since it's not a picky eater. It, however, doesn't share.
